scope: Provenance of two immutable public Zipformer artifact declarations. No recognition accuracy, device, accelerator, acoustic or release qualification is asserted.
sourceProof: The scanner controls pin these exact file blobs from the integration publication tree and recompute their SHA-1 object identities, lengths and SHA-256s. No unpublished local commit identity is required. The two model declarations bind the artifact length and SHA-256 to the complete immutable publisher URL and language-specific model enum. The independent publisher metadata in the model audit must agree on revision, blob identity and length. Missing, altered or non-blob source objects fail closed.

independentByteVerification.method: Read each retained publisher tokens.txt file as bytes; recompute SHA-256, the Git SHA-1 blob object identity and byte length. Both independent files match the immutable catalog and publisher metadata; each has 502 vocabulary rows. The model audit was preserved without renaming or hiding either declaration.
independentByteVerification.reproduction: Run scripts/test_gitleaks_model_pin.py --scanner PATH --recognition-model-root DIRECTORY with the English and French publisher files at zipformer-en/tokens.txt and zipformer-fr/tokens.txt. The default CI check binds committed provenance to immutable source objects without requiring network access or an old scratch pathname.

scannerPolicy.scope: Only the two fixed complete field/value lines with their trailing commas are exempt. Every other rule remains active. Changed values, another path or field, prefixed or trailing content, and adjacent synthetic credentials remain findings.
